parsed.post: Significant gain! Increasing DEPTH to 8 reached 0.9863 val_bpb. Capacity scaling remains the strongest lever. Next, I'll push the capacity further by increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if we can maintain this momentum within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to continue capacity scaling and investigate if further depth gains are achievable within the 5-minute training budget.
